demo.t0.mfs-lived-with.description: Married filing separately with mfs-lived-apart-all-year='no': draws line-6d guard_inapplicable on the MFS lived-with branch and line-6d-not-checked published_categorical.

demo.t0.mfj-spouse-records.description: Married filing jointly with a second W-2 slip for the spouse plus Form 1099-INT box 8 and Form 1099-DIV box 12 records and zero Form 1099 withholding.

demo.t0.no-w2-interest-only.description: Single return with closed-empty W-2 and W-2 box 2 families (line 25a computed_zero by absence) and $100 taxable interest on line 2b (Schedule B not required).

demo.t0.rounding-zeros-and-w2g-only.description: Sub-50-cent positive amounts rounding to $0 on lines 2a, 2b, 3a, 3b, 4b, 7a, 25a, 25b, 25c, 25d, 26, and Schedule D line 13, plus W-2G gambling winnings ($200) alone on Schedule 1 line 10 and Form 1040 line 8.

demo.t0.int8-only-and-unemp-plus-w2g.description: Form 1099-INT box 8 only ($300.40 rounded to $300) on line 2a, plus both Form 1099-G unemployment ($500.40 rounded to $500) and Form W-2G gambling winnings ($300) on Schedule 1 line 10 and Form 1040 line 8.

demo.t0.odc-no-and-corrected-retracted.description: Schedule 8812 line 6 computed_zero via the ctc.no-other-dependent='no' branch with zero qualifying dependents, plus a superseded estimated-tax answer ($250 -> $0) and a retracted-and-reasserted line 38 answer.

demo.t0.retracted-member-and-sch1-roundi.description: Form 1099-INT box 1 member ($500) asserted and then removed via member-transition (line 2b computed_zero after removal), W-2 wages $0.40 rounding to $0 (EIC Worksheet A line 2 computed_zero via line 1 < $1), and Form 1099-G box 1 $0.40 rounding to $0 (Schedule 1 lines 7/10 and Form 1040 line 8 computed_zero by rounding).
